name: Wildthyme Foods
description: Maker of ready meals and soups in the fictional city of Easterby.

items.title: Nutrition labels
items.content: Our soups average 1.1 g of salt per portion; the lasagne has 486 kcal. Sheet WTF-NUT-11.

items.title: Careers
items.content: Wildthyme employs 310 people and runs a chef apprenticeship starting each September. Page WTF-JOB-310.

items.title: Cook-chill rules
items.content: Meals are chilled to 4.8 C within 90 minutes in blast chiller BC-2; checks by Ilse Brandt. Rules WTF-CC-90.

items.title: Production planning meeting
items.content: Planning meets Thursdays at 13:05 in the Basil room; forecasts are in WTF-PLN-1305.

items.title: Office stationery account
items.content: Stationery comes from Penwise Office at about $380 a month on account WTF-STA-380, with free next-day delivery.

items.title: Private label contract
items.content: Wildthyme will make own-brand soups for Calloway Stores, 9.4 million pots a year at $0.87 each, from 2027-05-03. Contract WTF-PL-0503-C.
